summary: Implemented Windows visit-owned ordered root selection, stable hidden anchors, group/range selection and folded-heading select-all, plus the Kit toolbar and confirmed same-board move dialog. The native selected-board POST reuses current SelectedWrite authorization and store::move_selected_items; it does not change the distinct row-menu move operation. Review preserves original IDs, order, destination and operation identity, adopts revisions without writing, and requires separate confirmation. Uncertain results impose a read barrier, including after cancellation. Group-entry entities, row focus identities and folds survive refresh and read-only recovery. Documentation changes are limited to the affected workflow row and this handoff; pre-existing roadmap, runner and packet edits were preserved.
evidence: PASS: cargo test --locked -p boardcraft-desktop --features native-smoke --test windows_smoke windows_moves_selected_roots_to_group -- --exact --test-threads=1 --nocapture. Final repeat passed after boxing the enlarged visit state. Real Kit pointer, Space, Shift, Select and Escape inputs covered a hidden 59 anchor, folded-heading selection, Clear retaining the anchor, cancellation at g-20 without writing, a fresh operation on reopen, busy repeat-submit prevention and one ordered [67,59,61] POST to g-90. Fresh PostgreSQL snapshots and grouped/flat reads confirmed [73,77,67,59,61], selected revisions/stamps, neighbouring records and one receipt. The group draft and Reserve fold survived; mixed-group fill produced [73,77,67,59,61], and reload cleared selection without replay. Table-read counts were checked at every checkpoint.

PASS: cargo test --locked -p boardcraft-desktop --features native-smoke --test windows_smoke windows_reviews_selected_move -- --exact --test-threads=1 --nocapture. Eight isolated journeys covered a peer rename to Indigo/2, 409 with no receipt, fresh review, adoption with no write and deliberate focused-Confirm Enter saving Indigo/3; an unavailable original root with adoption disabled; demotion before confirm followed by an authorized read-only table with checks, focus and folds retained, local Clear, and the original group draft restored after access recovery; membership denial; substituted lost acknowledgment and failed post-commit refresh, each recovered by GET without another POST; Viewer-only selection; and an injected 503 range read retaining the prior checks until deliberate Shift retry. Mutation methods, paths, bodies, statuses and counts were checked independently of whole-store snapshots.

PASS: cargo test --locked -p boardcraft-mobile-edit-host --test loopback_board_access native_selection_move_checks_access_and_order -- --exact --nocapture. Actual native HTTP checked anonymous, hidden-board, direct-host, Viewer, removed-membership and revoked-session denial; nil operation, empty/duplicate selection, missing/foreign/hidden roots, invalid destinations and stale revisions. A deferred receipt commit refusal preserved the complete pre-attempt snapshot before repair. Success, reconnect, exact replay, altered-order refusal and replay under demotion preserved the expected destination order, revisions, stamps, provenance, neighbouring rows and receipt. Independent connections checked role, workspace membership, board subscriptions and session presence.

PASS: cargo test --locked -p boardcraft-desktop --bin boardcraft-desktop connected::main_table::selection::tests -- --nocapture. Both pure tests passed: ordered blocks and retained hidden anchors; reverse inclusive intervals, group removal, missing endpoints and anchor invalidation.

PASS focused regression: cargo test --locked -p boardcraft-desktop --features native-smoke --test windows_smoke windows_creates_and_renames_grouped_root -- --exact --test-threads=1 --nocapture. Existing create correction, draft identity, pending controls, name cancellation/blur/save, retained neighbouring draft and revisit readbacks passed with retained row entities.

PASS focused regression: cargo test --locked -p boardcraft-mobile-edit-host --test loopback_board_access preview_move_checks_group_revision_and_order -- --exact --nocapture. The distinct one-root row-menu position/revision and migration contract remained passing.

PASS: cargo clippy --locked -p boardcraft-desktop -p boardcraft-mobile-edit-host --bins -- -D warnings. The enlarged MainTable is boxed at Page::Items rather than suppressing the enum-size warning. PASS: cargo fmt --all -- --check and git diff --check. Final scope inspection found only the affected workflow row changed in documentation, alongside the owner's pre-existing roadmap/runner/packet work; no commits, pushes, deployments or verification-marker changes were made.

Verification limits: full packet/workspace suites, browser journeys and runner verification were deliberately not run by the worker. Native journeys use owned Windows processes, the existing disposable database fixture, actual Kit event routing and reduced motion for stable pointer geometry; they do not establish physical-device input, animated geometry, pixel fidelity, theme/zoom review or Android bulk-move parity. Native fixture builds retain the inherited unused-constant warnings in shared group fixtures. No clipboard or attended-owner check was used. No custom control or new migration was needed. Implementation and runtime evidence are linked from docs/workflows.md to crates/desktop/src/connected/main_table/selection_move.rs, crates/desktop/tests/windows/selection_move.rs and crates/mobile-edit-host/tests/fixture/native_selection_checks.rs.
